import json,urllib.request,urllib.parse,subprocess,datetime
base='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
def get(u,timeout=3):
 with urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=timeout) as r:return json.load(r)
def norm(u):
 try:
  z=urllib.parse.urlparse(u)
  return z.path.rstrip('/') if z.hostname in ('chatgpt.com','www.chatgpt.com') else ''
 except:return ''
c=get(base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats?inspect=0')['chats']
t=get('http://127.0.0.1:17410/json/list')
rows=[{'chat':x.get('name'),'exactTabCount':len([y for y in t if norm(y.get('url',''))==norm(x.get('url','')) and y.get('type')=='page']),'errorStatus':x.get('status')} for x in c]
p=subprocess.run(['git.exe','-C',r'E:\WebAIBridge','rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,timeout=4)
print(json.dumps({'at':datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds'),'head':p.stdout.decode().strip(),'rows':rows,'tabsUnchangedAndUnique':len(rows)==6 and all(x['exactTabCount']==1 for x in rows)},ensure_ascii=True))
